name: Portuna
tagline: The system of record for every slip, vessel, and berth you steward.
positioning: Portuna gives independent slip holders and small marina operators one authoritative ledger for berth assignments, dockage billing, and compliance.

hero.h1: Marina operations, held to a single source of truth.
hero.sub: Portuna consolidates berth assignments, dockage invoicing, and vessel documentation into one auditable platform — built for the boat owner and the operator managing forty slips alike.

features.title: Berth Assignment Ledger
features.description: Assign, reserve, and reconcile every slip against LOA, beam, and draft. Portuna flags conflicts before a vessel ever reaches the fairway.

features.title: Dockage & Utility Billing
features.description: Generate itemized dockage, power, and pump-out invoices on a fixed cycle. Meter reads, proration, and late fees calculate without a spreadsheet.

features.title: Documentation Compliance
features.description: Track insurance certificates, registration, and hull survey expirations per vessel, with automated notices before any lapse becomes a liability.

features.title: Tide & Weather Advisories
features.description: Berth-level alerts for storm surge, low-water windows, and NOAA advisories, routed to the tenants and vessels actually affected.

features.title: Tenant Portal
features.description: Give slip holders a self-service record of statements, contracts, and vessel details — replacing the shared inbox and the clipboard at the fuel dock.

features.title: Occupancy Reporting
features.description: Standing reports on occupancy, waitlist velocity, and revenue per linear foot, exportable for your board, lender, or accountant.

testimonials.quote: We managed 62 slips out of a binder and two spreadsheets. Portuna gave us a defensible ledger — when a tenant disputes a dockage charge, I pull the record in seconds.
testimonials.name: Diane Kellerman

testimonials.quote: I keep my sloop at three different harbors seasonally. Having every registration, insurance cert, and invoice in one authoritative place ended a genuinely tedious chore.
testimonials.name: Marcus Vellani

testimonials.quote: The documentation expiry alerts alone paid for the year. We haven't had a single lapsed insurance certificate slip through since we onboarded.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the individual owner tracking one to three vessels across any harbor.
For operators running a single marina with a real waitlist.
For multi-facility operators and municipal harbor districts.

homepage.footerBlurb: Portuna is the authoritative system of record for marina operations — from a single slip to a multi-facility port district.
